title: Inaudible
summary: INAUD'IBLE, adjective [in and audible.] That cannot be heard; as an inaudible voice or sound. 1. Making no sound; as the inaudible foot of time.

inlines.v: INAUD'IBLE, adjective [in and audible.] That cannot be heard; as an inaudible voice or sound. 1. Making no sound; as the inaudible foot of time.
